heading: 参考资料

sources.title: Introduction
supports: 生产者写入事件，消费者订阅读取事件；本片追踪有限事件集合。
Topic内记录分入分区，读取不会移走原日志；示例期间所有记录仍保留。

verification.method: Fresh complete HTTPS GETs of official fixed-commit Apache Kafka source through configured proxy; default TLS verification. Canonical kafka.apache.org HTML was not fetched. Raw frontmatter and focused mechanism/config paragraphs read directly; not a claim of reading every unrelated section.

quotation.text: Events in a topic can be read as often as needed-unlike traditional messaging systems, events are not deleted after consumption.

sources.title: Design
supports: 传统consumer group在稳定分配时，每分区在每组内只分给一个实例；同组实例按分区分工。
各独立组分别订阅同一日志；增加通知组实例不改变积分组的完整订阅。
本片不把传统组的分区独占规则扩大到Share Groups。
sources.sections: The Consumer / Consumer Position; The Share Consumer

verification.method: Fresh complete HTTPS GETs of official fixed-commit Apache Kafka source through configured proxy; default TLS verification. Canonical kafka.apache.org HTML was not fetched. Raw frontmatter and focused mechanism/config paragraphs read directly; not a claim of reading every unrelated section.

quotation.text: Our topic is divided into a set of totally ordered partitions, each of which is consumed by exactly one consumer within each subscribing consumer group at any given time.

scope: Two official original titles and institutional credits. KafkaConsumer.java lines94–123 cross-checks group.id, group-local partition ownership and independent logical subscriptions; ConsumerConfig.java lines120–123/182–190 checks explicitly selected classic protocol and earliest startup. These supporting config/API files are retained in evidence, not rendered as extra video bibliography rows.
